title: Bitcoin LIVE: Falling Wedge Breakout Loading! (target $85,000) - BTC, ETH, XRP Price Prediction
speaker: BitcoinHyper (host)

macro_themes.view: A second red October close in a row would be unprecedented and historically red Octobers were followed by red November/December, supporting a bigger ABC correction.
Fibonacci time projections put the next BTC/ETH cycle bottom around January-March 2027.

calls.condition: Holds long while above the recent low/value area low; if the falling wedge breaks up and BTC tags the 61.8% fib/liquidations near 84,500-84,600, expects a wave-2 top then a third-wave drop toward ~72,000 (1.618 ext, aligned with anchored VWAP); losing the recent low stops him out, re-long only on a swing-failure reclaim near 79,700.
calls.reason: Falling wedge read as a leading diagonal (wave 1 of a bearish C wave); short squeeze into short-liquidation cluster above highs, then 1.618 extension target; hidden bullish divergences on 2-day RSI/MFI/MACD support near-term bounce.
calls.quote: I am still expecting lower. However, in terms of the short-term prediction, because right here is the falling wedge pattern, we could be expecting... a bounce

calls.reason: Expanded-flat / ABC count; C-wave 1:1 and 0.618 extensions below recent lows; Fibonacci time points to a bottom around March 2027.
calls.quote: I do think Ethereum in this scenario, it is probably going to go below our recent lows right here.

notes: Date: listing says 2026-10-19 but host says 'middle of the weekend', so likely streamed 2026-10-18 (Sun). Invalidation 'below the recent low' is not given as an exact number; ~80,000 is the low he cites. At 44:59 he says wave-2 target 'above the recent high at approximately 74,500' - almost certainly a slip for 84,500. Lower possible targets mentioned: ~71,000 (0.5 retrace) and 62,500 in a deeper ABC drop. He also mentions having 're-entered' a BTC short (36:05), contradicting his stated long; treated long as main position.
